<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

<!-- PR title: [Type] scope: title, or [Type] [Hardware] scope: title.
Type: Feat, Fix, Refactor, Perf, Doc, Test, CI, or Chore.
Scope: any module or model name (no fixed list or letter-case restriction), e.g. attention, qwen3, or flash-attn.
Hardware: optional single tag without spaces. Use uppercase hardware tags (AMD, NVIDIA, NPU, MI300X), except for exactly these four spellings: Intel, Apple, Huawei, Ascend.
Title: no letter-case restriction.
Reverts: use GitHub's default title, Revert "original title".
Examples: [Fix] attention: Fix KV cache indexing; [Perf] [AMD] flash-attn: Optimize decode performance. -->

## Motivation

Builds uTLX (standalone TLX, for sglang's TLX kernels) into the ROCm 10 images for MI355X (`gfx950-rocm1000`) 

## Modifications

1. **Opt-in switch.** `--build-arg BUILD_UTLX=1` (default `0`) builds uTLX on `gfx950-rocm1000` and `gfx1250-rocm1000`, the two stages that set `UTLX_TRITON_PATCH`. Any other flavor fails at the start of the final stage rather than after the full build. Without it every flavor builds as before, and gfx950 keeps the SDK's Triton.
2. **Triton with plugin support.** With `BUILD_UTLX=1`, the Triton step builds the flavor's Triton from source into `/sgl-workspace/triton-custom` with `TRITON_EXT_ENABLED=ON`, plus a patch from `docker/patches/` that keeps libtriton's LLVM apart from the SDK's `libLLVM.so` (otherwise `import torch; import triton` segfaults):
   - gfx950: ROCm/triton `4cff872c`, the commit the SDK's wheel comes from, with ROCm/triton#983, which replaces ROCm/triton#978. The version stays `3.8.0+git4cff872c.rocm10.0.0`, which torch pins.
3. **uTLX.** Built from triton-ext `9592ce6` (triton-lang/triton-ext#179) against that Triton; `UTLX_TRITON_ROCM=1` on gfx950 selects its Triton release/3.8 code paths. Waiting this fix to be merged https://github.com/triton-lang/triton-ext/pull/183
4. **Kept in the image.** Triton's source, build tree and LLVM, and triton-ext (`/sgl-workspace/triton-ext`), stay in the image for in-place rebuilds. uTLX's tests and examples are in `/sgl-workspace/utlx`.
With `BUILD_UTLX=1`, gfx950 grows by about 15 GB (Triton's build tree and LLVM) and gets `triton_kernels`; on gfx1250, uTLX adds about 28 MB.


## Tests

**MI355X (gfx950-rocm1000)**, with the Triton and uTLX steps built on top of `rocm/sgl-dev:v0.5.22-rocm10-mi35x-20261028`:

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `import torch, triton, utlx_plugin`, in any order | ok |
| `import aiter, sglang` with uTLX loaded | ok |
| LLVM symbols bound between libtriton/libutlx and the SDK's libLLVM | 0 |
| uTLX test suite | 186 passed, 1 failed (below), 57 skipped |
| Same build without the patch (on the `20261022` image) | `import torch; import triton` segfaults |

## Checklist

- [ ] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

### PR Pundit review

(Testing PR Pundit Code Review agent. Not all comments may be relevant. This is a one-time automated pass: please address what is useful, no need to request a re-review. Please reply to each point, whether it applies or not: we harvest these replies, and both kinds are enormously helpful for tuning the agent. Reach out to @peymanr for suggestions.)

| # | | Finding | Where |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 🟠 | Released rocm10-mi35x images ship without uTLX: this PR adds BUILD_UTLX=0 opt-in unwired into CI | `docker/rocm.Dockerfile:424` |
| 2 | 🟠 | uTLX build fails at cherry-pick if ROCm/triton#983 SHA becomes unreachable: this PR hard-codes it | `docker/rocm.Dockerfile:1220` |
| 3 | 🟠 | uTLX plugin/Triton mismatch surfaces only at kernel compile time: this PR's uTLX step lacks a smoke test | `docker/rocm.Dockerfile:1278` |

#### 1. 🟠 Should fix: Released rocm10-mi35x images ship without uTLX: this PR adds BUILD_UTLX=0 opt-in unwired into CI
`docker/rocm.Dockerfile:424`

`BUILD_UTLX` defaults to `0`, and no workflow under `.github` passes `--build-arg BUILD_UTLX=1`. So the published `rocm10-mi35x` images built by `release-docker-amd-rocm10.yml` and `release-docker-amd.yml` do not contain uTLX, despite the PR title saying it is built into the gfx950 rocm10 images. The opt-in is deliberate and documented in the Dockerfile header ("Off by default"). Still, nothing in CI exercises the new path: the Triton cherry-pick, the plugin-enabled Triton source build and the uTLX build. Consider rewording the title as opt-in, or adding a matrix entry that builds it.

**Who is affected:** Users of the published gfx950-rocm1000 (rocm10-mi35x) images who expect uTLX to be included; also maintainers relying on CI to catch breakage in the opt-in uTLX build path.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

**Related past reviews:** [#30984](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/30984) on `docker/rocm.Dockerfile`, [#20731](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/20731) on `docker/Dockerfile`, [#27765](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/27765) on `.github/workflows/release-docker-amd-miles-rocm700-nightly.yml`, [#32754](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/32754) on `docker/rocm.Dockerfile`

#### 2. 🟠 Should fix: uTLX build fails at cherry-pick if ROCm/triton#983 SHA becomes unreachable: this PR hard-codes it
`docker/rocm.Dockerfile:1220`

The `ROCm/triton#983` cherry-pick (`89c3a46`) is a hard-coded SHA inside the Triton `RUN`, not an `ARG`/`ENV` like `TRITON_REVERT_COMMITS`, so it cannot be overridden without editing the Dockerfile. Today it is the head of `release/internal/3.8.x` and a plain `git clone` fetches it. If that branch is rewritten, the `git cherry-pick` step (not `git clone`) fails and the opt-in build stops. That the patched Triton keeps the SDK's version (`3.8.0+git4cff872c.rocm10.0.0`) is intentional, so torch's pin stays satisfied (stated in the PR comments). Consider exposing the SHA as a build arg.

**Who is affected:** Only image builds with `BUILD_UTLX=1` on `GPU_ARCH=gfx950-rocm1000`, and only if ROCm rewrites `release/internal/3.8.x`.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

**Related past reviews:** [#23263](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/23263) on `docker/rocm.Dockerfile`

#### 3. 🟠 Should fix: uTLX plugin/Triton mismatch surfaces only at kernel compile time: this PR's uTLX step lacks a smoke test
`docker/rocm.Dockerfile:1278`

The uTLX step installs the plugin without a post-install check (e.g. `python3 -c 'import triton'` with the `utlx` `.pth` loaded, compiling a trivial kernel). The Triton step has such a check at its end. A plugin/Triton mismatch or a plugin load failure would therefore only show when the image is used, not when it is built. Consider adding an import smoke test after the `pip install ./extensions/utlx`.

**Who is affected:** Image builders using `BUILD_UTLX=1` with `GPU_ARCH=gfx950-rocm1000`; the step is off by default.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

**Related past reviews:** [#36709](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/36709) on `docs/docs/hardware-platforms/mthreads_gpu.mdx`

<sub>Shared from a pilot of [PR Pundit](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/pr_pundit), an agentic code reviewer that builds and tests the change and reads the project's past reviews. Reviewed at `91bfdff0`; findings checked and posted by @peymanr; points already raised on this PR are left out.</sub>

LGTM,  build for uTLX is opt-in, and the gfx950 ci/nightly test all green, see: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/47231

Started the MI35x tests on `bingxche/sgl-test:v0.5.22-rocm10-mi35x-20261029_test_pr46883` (gfx950-rocm1000 with `BUILD_UTLX=1`, built in https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40846678113):

- PR Test (AMD, ROCm 10), MI35x stages only (`stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd-mi35x`, `stage-b-test-large-8-gpu-mi35x-disaggregation-amd`, `stage-c-test-large-8-gpu-amd-mi35x`): https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40871221634
- Nightly Test (AMD, ROCm 10), all 26 MI35x jobs: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40871225419

detail.title: [Chore] [AMD] docker: Build uTLX into the gfx950 rocm10 images

files.patch:
@@ -39,6 +39,11 @@
 # At runtime use --disaggregation-transfer-backend nixl (env is wired via /etc/bash.bashrc).
 #   docker build --build-arg SGL_BRANCH=v0.5.17 --build-arg GPU_ARCH=gfx950-rocm720 -t v0.5.17-rocm720-mi35x -f rocm.Dockerfile .
 
+# Usage (to build SGLang ROCm + uTLX docker image, for sglang's TLX kernels):
+# Off by default. BUILD_UTLX=1 builds it on gfx950-rocm1000 and fails on every
+# other flavor.
+#   docker build --build-arg SGL_BRANCH=v0.5.17 --build-arg GPU_ARCH=gfx950-rocm1000 --build-arg BUILD_UTLX=1 -t v0.5.17-rocm10-mi35x -f rocm.Dockerfile .
+
 # Default base images
 ARG BASE_IMAGE_942="rocm/sgl-dev:rocm7-vllm-20250904"
 ARG BASE_IMAGE_942_ROCM720="rocm/pytorch:rocm7.2_ubuntu22.04_py3.10_pytorch_release_2.9.1"
@@ -318,7 +323,14 @@ RUN mkdir -p /etc/sglang/constraints && : > /etc/sglang/constraints/torch-rocm.t
 # Base image 950 with ROCm 10.0.0 and args (Python 3.12 + torch 2.11)
 FROM $BASE_IMAGE_950_ROCM1000 AS gfx950-rocm1000
 ENV BUILD_VLLM="0"
+# Keeps the SDK's Triton. uTLX (BUILD_UTLX=1, see the uTLX step) needs Triton
+# with plugin support, which the SDK's lacks, so then it is replaced by the
+# commit the SDK's wheel comes from, built from source like gfx1250's; the
+# suffix keeps the version torch pins.
 ENV BUILD_TRITON="0"
+ENV TRITON_REPO_DEFAULT="https://github.com/ROCm/triton.git"
+ENV TRITON_COMMIT_DEFAULT="4cff872ced001ea92d9fcf05b3f6517e2b486d19"
+ENV TRITON_WHEEL_VERSION_SUFFIX=".rocm10.0.0"
 ENV BUILD_LLVM="0"
 ENV BUILD_AITER_ALL="1"
 ENV BUILD_MOONCAKE="1"
@@ -402,10 +414,19 @@ ARG BRANCH_TYPE=remote
 # Version override for setuptools_scm (used in nightly builds)
 ARG SETUPTOOLS_SCM_PRETEND_VERSION=""
 
-ARG TRITON_REPO="https://github.com/triton-lang/triton.git"
+ARG TRITON_REPO=""
+ENV TRITON_REPO="${TRITON_REPO:-${TRITON_REPO_DEFAULT:-https://github.com/triton-lang/triton.git}}"
 ENV TRITON_COMMIT="${TRITON_COMMIT:-${TRITON_COMMIT_DEFAULT}}"
 ARG TRITON_REVERT_COMMITS=""
 ENV TRITON_REVERT_COMMITS="${TRITON_REVERT_COMMITS:-${TRITON_REVERT_COMMITS_DEFAULT}}"
+# uTLX (see the uTLX step), off by default and only on gfx950-rocm1000; checked
+# here, not at the end of the build.
+ARG BUILD_UTLX="0"
+ENV BUILD_UTLX="${BUILD_UTLX}"
+RUN if [ "${BUILD_UTLX}" = "1" ] && [ "${GPU_ARCH}" != "gfx950-rocm1000" ]; then \
+        echo "[uTLX] BUILD_UTLX=1 is not supported for GPU_ARCH=${GPU_ARCH}"; \
+        exit 1; \
+    fi
 
 # ROCm 7.2 Triton (BUILD_TRITON=1 stages only). Both wheels are the same
 # upstream revision, triton-lang/triton@89002410. AITER only requires
@@ -1173,10 +1194,14 @@ RUN cd /tmp/whl \
 # is what drops that pin, so installing Triton any earlier lets the next pip
 # install pull CUDA torch instead. The hip check below is the tripwire.
 # torch 2.11 names this `triton-rocm`; uninstall it so the pin is the only Triton.
-RUN if [ "$BUILD_TRITON" = "1" ]; then \
+#
+# With BUILD_UTLX=1 (see the uTLX step below) the source build also gets plugin
+# support, so the build tree is written once; gfx950-rocm1000 builds Triton from
+# source only then.
+RUN if [ "$BUILD_TRITON" = "1" ] || [ "$BUILD_UTLX" = "1" ]; then \
         case "${GPU_ARCH}" in \
-          gfx1250-rocm1000|gfx1250-rocm1010) \
-            echo "[Triton] gfx1250: building ${TRITON_COMMIT} from source"; \
+          gfx950-rocm1000|gfx1250-rocm1000|gfx1250-rocm1010) \
+            echo "[Triton] building ${TRITON_COMMIT} from ${TRITON_REPO}"; \
             pip uninstall -y triton triton-rocm || true \
             && apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends cmake && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
             && git clone ${TRITON_REPO} triton-custom \
@@ -1190,6 +1215,11 @@ RUN if [ "$BUILD_TRITON" = "1" ]; then \
                  git -c user.email=build@sglang -c user.name=sglang-build \
                      commit -q -am "Revert $rev" || exit 1; \
                done \
+            && if [ "${BUILD_UTLX}" = "1" ]; then \
+                 # ROCm/triton#983; uncommitted so the version keeps the hash torch pins.
+                 git cherry-pick --no-commit 89c3a46ba4908396313782443229eee3541a08f2 \
+                 && export TRITON_EXT_ENABLED=ON; \
+               fi \
             && pip install -r python/requirements.txt \
             && pip install -e . \
             && if [ -d python/triton_kernels ]; then pip install -e python/triton_kernels --no-deps; fi; \
@@ -1207,6 +1237,47 @@ RUN if [ "$BUILD_TRITON" = "1" ]; then \
 # torch 2.11 still Requires-Dist: triton-rocm after the swap above.
 RUN case "${GPU_ARCH}" in *-rocm724|gfx1250-rocm1010) python3 -c "import pathlib,re,importlib.metadata as m; p=pathlib.Path(m.distribution('torch')._path)/'METADATA'; v=m.version('triton'); t,n=re.subn(r'^Requires-Dist: (?:triton|triton-rocm)==[^\s;]+', 'Requires-Dist: triton=='+v, p.read_text(), count=1, flags=re.M); assert n==1, n; p.write_text(t)" ;; esac
 
+# -----------------------
+# uTLX (standalone TLX) for sglang's TLX kernels, built with BUILD_UTLX=1 on
+# gfx950-rocm1000. The Triton step above builds its Triton from source in
+# /sgl-workspace/triton-custom with plugin support (TRITON_EXT_ENABLED=ON) and
+# ROCm/triton#983; this step builds the uTLX plugin against it, from
+# /sgl-workspace/triton-ext. Both stay in the image, with Triton's build tree
+# and LLVM, to rebuild in place.
+#
+# Triton release/3.8 does not install the C++ headers uTLX compiles against,
+# so then they come from the build tree, staged outside the source tree
+# because the component also copies python/ into include/. uTLX's examples and
+# tests are also copied to /sgl-workspace/utlx: triton-ext lists uTLX as
+# disabled, so its conftest.py skips them in the checkout.
+ARG UTLX_REPO="https://github.com/triton-lang/triton-ext.git"
+# triton-ext main at #183. With uTLX loaded, #177 keeps Gluon kernels (e.g.
+# aiter's) compiling, and #183 tl.cat and tensor-returning noinline functions
+# (e.g. MiniMax's sparse-attention indexer).
+ARG UTLX_COMMIT="268252bcc64e13b553b7906e5b69f02fa69054fb"
+RUN if [ "${BUILD_UTLX}" = "1" ]; then \
+        echo "[uTLX] building ${UTLX_COMMIT} against /sgl-workspace/triton-custom"; \
+        cd /sgl-workspace/triton-custom \
+        && if [ ! -d python/triton/include ]; then \
+             cmake --install build/cmake.* --component headers --prefix /tmp/triton-headers \
+             && mv /tmp/triton-headers/include python/triton/include \
+             && rm -rf /tmp/triton-headers; \
+           fi \
+        && git clone ${UTLX_REPO} /sgl-workspace/triton-ext \
+        && cd /sgl-workspace/triton-ext \
+        && git checkout ${UTLX_COMMIT} \
+        && unset CPATH LIBRARY_PATH \
+        && export TRITON_WHEEL_DIR=/sgl-workspace/triton-custom/python/triton \
+        && export LLVM_INSTALL_DIR="$(readlink -f /root/.triton/llvm/llvm-ubuntu-x64)" \
+        # UTLX_TRITON_ROCM selects uTLX's code for ROCm's Triton release/3.8.
+        && pip install --no-build-isolation --no-deps \
+               --config-settings=cmake.define.UTLX_TRITON_ROCM=ON \
+               ./extensions/utlx \
+        && mkdir -p /sgl-workspace/utlx \
+        && cp -r extensions/utlx/examples extensions/utlx/test /sgl-workspace/utlx/ \
+        && rm -rf /root/.cache/pip; \
+    fi
+

| # | | Finding | Where |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 🟠 | Released rocm10-mi35x images ship without uTLX: this PR adds BUILD_UTLX=0 opt-in unwired into CI | `docker/rocm.Dockerfile:424` |
| 2 | 🟠 | uTLX build fails at cherry-pick if ROCm/triton#983 SHA becomes unreachable: this PR hard-codes it | `docker/rocm.Dockerfile:1220` |

#### 1. 🟠 Should fix: Released rocm10-mi35x images ship without uTLX: this PR adds BUILD_UTLX=0 opt-in unwired into CI
`docker/rocm.Dockerfile:424`

`BUILD_UTLX` defaults to `0`, and no workflow under `.github` passes `--build-arg BUILD_UTLX=1`. So the published `rocm10-mi35x` images built by `release-docker-amd-rocm10.yml` and `release-docker-amd.yml` do not contain uTLX, despite the PR title saying it is built into the gfx950 rocm10 images. The opt-in is deliberate and documented in the Dockerfile header ("Off by default"). Still, nothing in CI exercises the new path: the Triton cherry-pick, the plugin-enabled Triton source build and the uTLX build. Consider rewording the title as opt-in, or adding a matrix entry that builds it.

**Who is affected:** Users of the published gfx950-rocm1000 (rocm10-mi35x) images who expect uTLX to be included; also maintainers relying on CI to catch breakage in the opt-in uTLX build path.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

**Related past reviews:** [#30984](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/30984) on `docker/rocm.Dockerfile`, [#20731](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/20731) on `docker/Dockerfile`, [#27765](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/27765) on `.github/workflows/release-docker-amd-miles-rocm700-nightly.yml`, [#32754](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/32754) on `docker/rocm.Dockerfile`

#### 2. 🟠 Should fix: uTLX build fails at cherry-pick if ROCm/triton#983 SHA becomes unreachable: this PR hard-codes it
`docker/rocm.Dockerfile:1220`

The `ROCm/triton#983` cherry-pick (`89c3a46`) is a hard-coded SHA inside the Triton `RUN`, not an `ARG`/`ENV` like `TRITON_REVERT_COMMITS`, so it cannot be overridden without editing the Dockerfile. Today it is the head of `release/internal/3.8.x` and a plain `git clone` fetches it. If that branch is rewritten, the `git cherry-pick` step (not `git clone`) fails and the opt-in build stops. That the patched Triton keeps the SDK's version (`3.8.0+git4cff872c.rocm10.0.0`) is intentional, so torch's pin stays satisfied (stated in the PR comments). Consider exposing the SHA as a build arg.

**Who is affected:** Only image builds with `BUILD_UTLX=1` on `GPU_ARCH=gfx950-rocm1000`, and only if ROCm rewrites `release/internal/3.8.x`.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

**Related past reviews:** [#23263](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/23263) on `docker/rocm.Dockerfile`

#### 3. 🟠 Should fix: uTLX plugin/Triton mismatch surfaces only at kernel compile time: this PR's uTLX step lacks a smoke test
`docker/rocm.Dockerfile:1278`

The uTLX step installs the plugin without a post-install check (e.g. `python3 -c 'import triton'` with the `utlx` `.pth` loaded, compiling a trivial kernel). The Triton step has such a check at its end. A plugin/Triton mismatch or a plugin load failure would therefore only show when the image is used, not when it is built. Consider adding an import smoke test after the `pip install ./extensions/utlx`.

**Who is affected:** Image builders using `BUILD_UTLX=1` with `GPU_ARCH=gfx950-rocm1000`; the step is off by default.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

**Related past reviews:** [#36709](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/36709) on `docs/docs/hardware-platforms/mthreads_gpu.mdx`
